messages.content: Help me decode a 9-patch image from an input stream `imageInputStream` and write the decoded PNG image to an output stream `imageOutputStream`?

function.name: Res9patchStreamDecoder_decode
function.description: Decodes a 9-patch image from the given input stream and writes the decoded PNG image to the specified output stream. Returns true if the operation is successful, otherwise false. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

input.description: The input stream containing the 9-patch image data. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

out.description: The output stream where the decoded PNG image will be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
